name: cf-tunnel
description: Cloudflare Tunnel public hostname route management: narrow broker API (list/add/remove with hostname allowlist) so sessions never hold the CF API token.
cardTemplate: Summarise the "cf-tunnel" domain: narrow Cloudflare Tunnel route broker (allowlisted hostnames only) keeping the CF API token inside Excubitor.
rationale: External-edge (Cloudflare) route management is a distinct trust boundary: credentials stay in Excubitor, sessions get only narrow allowlisted operations.
